subject: Weekly executive snapshot: wins, risks, and concise asks
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly exec snapshot: wins, risks, and concise asks

Team — sending a very short exec-friendly update for this week. If you want anything expanded for Thursday's QBR packet, shout and I'll add.

Wins
- Hosted API: 18% improvement in 99th p latency after kernel tweak (observability shows stable CPU/GPU utilization). Customer-facing latencies improved in APAC and US.
- Pipeline: Voltix POC moved to legal review after pilot success (see SOW draft attached). Potential $650k ARR if pilot converts.
- Dedicated: One new reserved commitment queued to close next month (prelim term sheet signed).

Risks / Signals
- Quality drift: Small regression observed on long-form summaries (internal evals). Root cause narrow — tokenizer/LM alignment on continued prompts. ML triage in progress; worst-case mitigation is rolling back to prior model variant for 48 hours.
- Supply squeeze: Partner GPU vendor flagged a potential 6‑week delay for a specific 8xA100 SKU. Mitigation plan: burst to multi-region pools and enable additional quantization profile.
- Renewal friction: A mid-market account flagged price sensitivity; may request a 20% credit to renew.

Asks (short, actionable)
1) Approve $25k one-time promotional credit for the mid-market renewal if it secures a 12‑month commit (decision requested by Wed EOD). Owner: laura_bennett.
2) Assign SOC2 evidence owner to bucket and complete the COA checklist by next Tue. Owner: marissa_cole (I've attached the evidence request).
3) OK to share the QBR one-pager with Voltix (they've asked for a one-page ops summary before legal finishes SOW). Owner: ben_carter.

Attachments: QBR_onepager.pdf (summary), Voltix_SOW_draft.docx (draft), SOC2_evidence_request.xlsx (evidence checklist)

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly exec snapshot: wins, risks, and concise asks

Ben — thanks for the concise update. A couple quick asks from my side: 

- Can you quantify the APAC latency delta in percent and approx token throughput impact? Need a single bullet for the QBR slide.
- On the credit ask: what's the expected ARR impact if we deny vs approve? Put a 1‑line recommendation (approve/decline) and rationale.
- SOC2 evidence: if Marissa owns it, please add an explicit escalation path (who to hit on infra/legal) if blockers appear.

Also please avoid sending Voltix anything that contains pricing language until legal finishes redlines. The one-pager can be ops-only.

On the quality drift: can ML include an eval snapshot (before/after) in the packet? We need to avoid surprises.

Laura
Laura Bennett
COO, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly exec snapshot: wins, risks, and concise asks

Laura — quick answers inline and next steps: 

> Can you quantify the APAC latency delta in percent and approx token throughput impact?
- APAC 99p latency down 22%; token throughput increased ~12% at 2‑4 concurrent requests per host in our smoke tests. I'll add a one-line stat to the QBR slide.

> On the credit ask: what's the expected ARR impact if we deny vs approve?
- Approve: likely converts to a 12‑month $650k ARR (conservative). Deny: customer has signaled 50% chance to churn or move to competitor pricing — expected ARR loss ~$420k. Recommendation: approve with standard T&Cs to secure 12 months.

> SOC2 evidence: escalation path
- Owner: marissa_cole. Escalation: if infra artifacts unavailable >48 hrs, escalate to neha_kapoor (infra lead) then to legal (priyom for contractual clarifications). I'll add this timeline to the checklist.

> ML eval snapshot
- Will request a 1-slide before/after with sample tokens and perf numbers from Maya's team; ETA: Tue EOD.

Next steps I'm taking now:
- Update QBR one-pager with the APAC stat and ops-only content for Voltix; attaching v2.
- Send legal the SOW (Voltix_SOW_draft.docx) and loop DocuSign contact once redlines are applied.

Attachments: QBR_onepager_v2.pdf (ops-only)

Ben

Thanks — noted and appreciate the short format. Two quick notes:
- Looping legal: I've pinged legal (internal) to prioritize Voltix SOW review; I'll share redlines by EOD Wed.
- On the GPU supply risk: recommend we draft a short contingency clause in Dedicated contracts to allow temporary regional bursts. I'll draft language and share tomorrow.

Priyom
Priyom Das
General Counsel, Redwood Inference
